answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 157914 Country: India Title: Can we eat broiler chicken or egg? Is it halal or haram? Please give reply as soon as possible. Question: Can we eat broiler chicken or egg? Is it halal or haram? Please give reply as soon as possible. Answer ID: 157914 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 400/361/M=4/1439) Broiler chicken is halal. If it is slaughtered according to Shariah then it is halal and you may eat it as well as its egg. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
